purpose: A practical registry of major public LLM and agent benchmarks. It is metadata only: record per-model scores separately with prompt, harness, version, and date.
selectionPolicy: Includes widely used, influential, or currently relevant public benchmarks across software engineering, agents, general reasoning, multimodal, long context, tools, safety, retrieval, and multilingual evaluation. It is intentionally not a claim to enumerate every benchmark ever published.

scoreRecordShape.source: official leaderboard URL or experiment artifact
